description: Election Commission - Elected Pannala Gedara Kusumavathi as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nomination by a political party and the official declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. The content is specifically about electoral processes and filling elected positions at the local government level, making it a clear fit for the Elections category.
